answer: Mechanism: per-identity stake + slashing. Before any vote or grade, each identity must lock 500 USDC in a staking contract and pass one unique-human KYC, registering that deposit against a single orchard parcel, meadow parcel, and lotus pond lease from public land records. A farm of 1000 clones pays 500,000 USDC; the audit catches one physical operator reusing the same orchard, meadow, and lotus identifiers across all 1000 deposits and slashes 100%. Honesty stays cheaper.
